text: Selected under delegation (LLM choice): Kieran works for the White Hart Building Society (staff say 'the Hart'), an invented mutual founded in 1868 by Swindon railwaymen meeting at a White Hart inn, head office and payments operations in west Swindon. It stands in for the town's real mutuals, which stay unnamed. A white animal sits in the old institution's name without anyone in the story remarking on it.
